title: "RV1007: <script> / <style> JSX content"

**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Script/style JSX content is not supported; use css`` from @rivetjs/runtime/css or build-time assets
```

```text
Script/style JSX content is not supported; use build-time assets
```

## How to fix

Remove the `<style>/<script>` children: put CSS in a css`` block (import `{ css }` from "@rivetjs/runtime/css") or a .css import, and scripts in a module/asset. Page-level inline code goes through the route head: a head styles entry `{ css }` for an inline `<style>`, a head scripts entry `{ inline: unsafeInlineScript(code), strategy: "body" }` (unsafeInlineScript from @rivetjs/kit, or `<Script inline={unsafeInlineScript(code)} strategy="body" />`) for an inline `<script>` at the end of `<body>`; both carry the request's CSP nonce.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <style>{".a{color:red}"}</style>;
```

```tsx prefer
import { css } from "@rivetjs/runtime/css";
const s = css`.a { color: red }`;
export const A = () => <p class={s.a} />;
```
